none.comment: READMEs and changelogs no longer feed the build cache key, so a docs edit does not rebuild every dependent project
The build now checks that every file under src parses as native JavaScript
The package no longer ships a compiled lib directory, which nothing imported; main points at src like the exports do

minor.comment: Give the window a PointerEvent stand-in and the pointer capture methods, which jsdom lacks, so a test of code that sends pointer events need not keep its own copy

patch.comment: Built with TypeScript 7. skipLibCheck moved into the shared package tsconfig base, because @types/jsdom does not satisfy TypeScript 7's index-signature conformance check.

none.comment: Rename @apendua.dev/jsdom-env to @apendua/jsdom-env and publish it under the @apendua scope
